transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. Well, I guess... I've just been having some trouble at work lately. I do ad sales, and... we have these really long strategy meetings. I just... I keep getting up when I know I'm supposed to stay in my chair. Like, I'll just go refill my water or... pace by the printer for a minute. So... yeah, that's basically what made me come in.
Do you feel like you're choosing to get up from your chair during these meetings, or does it feel like you're doing it without really thinking about it?
Um... I don't really know. Like I said, I know I'm supposed to stay seated during those meetings, but... I don't really think about it. I just sort of... end up getting up.
Do you feel anxious or on edge in other situations, outside of these work meetings?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I feel on edge or anything like that. Just... normal, I guess.
Do you feel like you have to perform certain rituals or routines in your daily life?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really do anything like that. Just... normal stuff, I guess.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still in other situations, like when you're watching TV or eating dinner?
Um... not really. I mean, I haven't really noticed doing that. When I'm eating or watching TV, I'm just... doing that, I guess. I don't think I feel restless then.
Do you have any recurring thoughts that you can't seem to get out of your head?
No... I don't think so. Nothing really gets stuck like that. Just normal thoughts.
Do you often find yourself talking more than others in social situations?

Um... I guess sometimes. Like... at work. If we're doing team pitches, I'll realize I've been talking about the campaign idea for kind of a long time. And... when I finally stop, it's pretty obvious the others were just waiting for a turn to say something. But... yeah. I guess that happens.
When you realize you've been talking for a long time in social situations, do you feel like you're choosing to keep talking?

Um... I don't know. I guess I'm not really thinking about it like that. I'm just... talking, and then I realize I've been talking for a while. So... no, I don't think I'm choosing it. It just happens.
Do you also find yourself talking more than others in social situations outside of work?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I mostly just notice it at work. Outside of that... I haven't really noticed it happening.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking through the consequences?
Um... I don't think so. I mean... I'm not really sure what you mean by that. But... no, I don't think I do that.
Do you ever have thoughts that come into your mind that you try to ignore or suppress?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't think I have thoughts like that. Just normal stuff, I guess. So, no.
Do you often find yourself dominating conversations with friends or family, similar to what you described happening at work?
I don't think so. Um... my family hasn't ever said anything about it. So... it's mostly just when I'm working, I think.
Do you feel like your behavior at work is causing problems for you or affecting your relationships with your coworkers?

Um... I guess so. It's... it's started showing up in my performance reviews. And... well, there was a complaint from a client recently. About trust, I guess. It just made me worry that I might damage my accounts... even though I really care about doing good work. So... yeah. It's causing some issues.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others when they are speaking?

Um... I guess sometimes. Like... if someone is working through a deck at work, and I get an idea... I might just pop over. Or... interrupt their conversation to add my thought. Even if... well, I guess it probably could have waited. So... yeah.
Are you experiencing any problems in your personal relationships or daily life outside of work due to your behavior?
Um... not really, no. My personal life is fine. It's... it's just work stuff, mostly.
Do you feel like your behavior at work is causing you a lot of stress or emotional discomfort?
Um... not really. I mean... it's just work. I wouldn't say it's causing a lot of stress or... emotional stuff. It's just... something I need to fix, I guess.
Do you feel like your behavior at work is causing you significant emotional distress?
No. Like I just said... it's not really distressing. It's just a work issue.
Have you been experiencing these behaviors, like getting up during meetings and interrupting others, for as long as you can remember?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... way before high school, really. 

I know my elementary school teachers used to write notes about it. Just... saying I was bright but rushed through things. Or that I talked out of turn and forgot my homework. They always complained my desk was stuffed with half-finished papers. So... yeah, it's been a while.
Do you think your behaviors have caused you to have difficulty making or keeping friends?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean... I have friends. It's not really something I've had a problem with, I guess.
